question: In which year was the Badminton Association of India formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1934.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __**Key Points**__

__
 
• The Badminton Association of India is the governing body of badminton in India.
 
• It was formed in 1934 and has been holding national-level tournaments in India since 1936.
 
• BAI is an association registered under the Society’s act.
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Himanta Biswa Sarma has been elected as the new president of the Badminton Association of India (BAI).(Sept 2022)
 
• He was elected unopposed during the federation election in Goa on April 3, 2018. 
 
• He will serve as the president for a term of four years.
 
• He was the interim president of BAI last year because of the demise of former president Akhilesh Das Gupta.
